beat: Cinema foyer and four-seat shuffle: Sharmi claims John's adjacent seat, Raj joins Dhika

lines.original: She was wearing a simple but elegant Cherry red saree that looked blood red on her milky white skin.... In her entire mid body, the red saree was missing to cover only one small place and that was a tiny bit of her hip exposed on her side.
lines.local: Dhika ne simple lekin elegant cherry-red saree pehni thi, jo uski milky-white skin par blood-red lag rahi thi. Saree mid-body par lagbhag poori cover thi, bas side par hip ka chhota sa hissa dikh raha tha.

lines.original: Dhika: feeling a little blushed... where is Raj ?
lines.local: Dhika thoda blush karte hue: Raj kahan hai?

lines.original: Sharmi: oh, he went to the rest room... common lets go inside.....he will join us
lines.local: Sharmi: Oh, restroom gaya hai. Chalo andar, woh humse mil lega.

lines.original: Sharmi as usual walked hand in hand with John while Dhika followed them innocently like a third wheel, thinking why she is being the third wheel here....
lines.local: Hamesha ki tarah Sharmi, John ka haath pakadkar saath chali; Dhika unke peeche seedhi-saadhi third wheel ki tarah, soch rahi thi ki yahan third wheel woh kyun ban gayi.

lines.original: When they reached the seats (  it was a four seater corner place), John took the right most one and while Dhika was about to move next to John, Sharmi sat quickly in her place.
lines.local: Corner mein chaar seats thin. John sabse daayen baitha; Dhika uske bagal mein jaane lagi, lekin Sharmi jaldi se uski jagah baith gayi.

lines.original: Dhika: oi... move
lines.local: Dhika: Oi, hato!

lines.original: Sharmi: hehe... why ... you were slow..
lines.local: Sharmi: Hehe, kyun? Tum slow thi.

lines.original: Dhika: don't play Sharmii... moveeee...
lines.local: Dhika: Drama mat karo Sharmiii, hatooo!

lines.original: Sharmi: what play... you are having him whole time for yourself.... let me, just this one time, sit with him......
lines.local: Sharmi: Kaisa drama? John toh hamesha tumhare paas rehta hai. Bas ek baar mujhe uske bagal mein baithne do.

lines.original: John just kept smiling looking at the two playfully fighting..
lines.local: Dono ki playful nok-jhonk dekhkar John bas muskurata raha.

lines.original: Dhika: what will Raj think... move soon....
lines.local: Dhika: Raj kya sochega? Jaldi hato.

lines.original: Sharmi: oh, while coming itself I told him that I am sitting next to John whatever happens...... she winked at Dhika..
lines.local: Sharmi: Arre, aate waqt hi Raj ko bol diya tha, chahe jo ho main John ke bagal mein baithungi. Usne Dhika ko wink kiya.

lines.original: Dhika: hitting her head herself... do whatever you want, atleast you both switch to the middle seats so that I can sit next John.....
lines.local: Dhika ne apna maatha peeta: Jo chahe karo! Kam-se-kam tum dono middle seats mein shift ho jao taaki main John ke paas baith sakun.

lines.original: John laughed and was about to stand up to move when Sharmi put a hand across his lap.... across his crotch...
lines.local: John hanskar uthne hi wala tha ki Sharmi ne uski lap ke across, uske crotch par haath rakh diya.

lines.original: John felt it and Dhika noticed it....
lines.local: John ne touch mehsoos kiya aur Dhika ne yeh dekha.

lines.original: Sharmi: hehe... why sweetie... you won't sit here ? afraid of my husband ?
lines.local: Sharmi: Hehe, kyun sweetie, yahan nahi baithogi? Mere husband se dar lagta hai?

lines.original: Dhika: what ? no no...if anything I am afraid of you more than Raj..hehe....
lines.local: Dhika: Kya? Nahi-nahi! Agar kisi se darr hai toh Raj se zyada tumse, hehe.

lines.original: Sharmi: then sit here.... she put a tongue out..
lines.local: Sharmi: Toh yahin baitho! Usne jeebh nikaalkar chidhaya.

lines.original: Looking a bit worried and confused, she looked towards John...
lines.local: Thodi worried aur confused Dhika ne John ki taraf dekha.

lines.original: John: consoling her with just his eyes, he said... its okay dear, sit. I am sure Raj would like your company.
lines.local: John ne aankhon se reassure karke kaha: Theek hai dear, baith jao. Raj ko tumhari company pasand aayegi, pakka.

lines.original: Feeling a little blushed and worried, she sat quietly not wanting to argue anymore.....
lines.local: Dhika thodi blush aur chinta ke saath chupchaap baith gayi. Ab aur behas nahi karna chahti thi.

lines.original: Just when the movie was about to start, Raj came running and he had to move through all 3 to get to his seat.... when he saw Sharmi sitting next to John, he gave a quick subtle grinning smile towards Sharmi and moved and sat next to Dhika.
lines.local: Film shuru hone se pehle Raj bhaagta hua aaya; apni seat tak pahunchne ko teeno ke saamne se guzarna pada. Sharmi ko John ke bagal mein dekhkar usne Sharmi ko halki, subtle grin di aur Dhika ke bagal mein baith gaya.

lines.original: John: quietly... Sharmi... did you and Raj plan this. ?
lines.local: John dheere se: Sharmi, kya tum aur Raj ne yeh plan kiya tha?

lines.original: Sharmi: oh no.... but I did.... winking... for me... hehe.
lines.local: Sharmi: Oh nahi... lekin maine kiya tha. Mere liye, hehe! Phir wink kiya.

lines.original: John: and Raj didn't mind it..........anything.....
lines.local: John: Aur Raj ko isse... koi problem nahi hui?

lines.original: Sharmi: lets just say Raj and I are very close and have an understanding.... she winked at him again..
lines.local: Sharmi: Bas itna samajh lo, Raj aur main bahut close hain aur hamari understanding hai. Usne phir wink kiya.

lines.original: John wasn't very clear on what she meant, but for now, he dropped the conversation as the movie started.
lines.local: Sharmi ki baat ka John ko poora matlab clear nahi hua; movie shuru hote hi usne baat wahin chhod di.
